newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Carding wool firm/dearer at Australian sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Carding wool firm/dearer at Australian sale.

text.p: The Australian wool market was fully firm to dearer at Tuesday's auction of carding wool at Launceston, Wool International said.
The eastern market indicator was unavailable because no combing wool was sold at Launceston, the only auction centre selling on Tuesday, it said.
WI said that lambs and crutchings were fully firm, locks of 20 micron and finer were slightly dearer, while 21/22m were two percent dearer, and stains three percent dearer.
WI said there was general competition for the wool with most sectors, including local mills, active.
Of the 3,863 bales offered, 5.4 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney, Launceston and Fremantle with about 36,600 bales to be offered.
